data.body: Partial staleness note (2026-06-03): ROOT CAUSE B's counting mechanics were superseded by the bug-2b01 fix (merged to main via PR #609, commit 852e3ea6ab) — auto-resume.md clause (b) now uses a single 'ticket list --status=open,in_progress' call with a python json-length count instead of the brace-group + grep -c pattern. ROOT CAUSE A (alias not resolved by --parent: '--parent=waxen-sigma' returns [] while '--parent=99f1-153c' returns the 11 children) is NOT fixed and still yields ACTIVE=0 for alias-selected epics. Ticket remains open on root cause A.
